_comment: Best-effort per-1M-token USD price estimates for cost tracking ONLY. NOT authoritative billing. Models absent here (image/audio/realtime/tts/video/rerank/transcription) record cost as unknown rather than zero. inputPer1M/outputPer1M are USD per 1,000,000 tokens.
_source: Azure Retail Prices API (https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices), serviceName eq 'Foundry Models'. Rates are undiscounted PAYG list price for the GlobalStandard SKU the catalog actually deploys ('... Gl'/'... glbl' meters), excluding Batch, Priority Processing, cached-input, and Provisioned meters. Refresh by re-querying that API rather than by reading the marketing pricing page, whose figures render client-side.
_caveats: Flat per-model rates cannot express every Azure meter dimension. (1) Long-context: gpt-5.4/5.4-pro bill a higher tier above 272k tokens and the gpt-5.6 family above its short-context tier - roughly 2x these rates. (2) Cached input bills ~10% of input and is not modeled, so estimates are conservative (over-report) on cache-heavy traffic. (3) Priority Processing bills ~2x standard; the app's own P0/P1 fairness queue is a proxy-side concept and does NOT put traffic on those meters. (4) model-router has no meter of its own - it bills as whichever model it routes to, so its entry is a mid-range stand-in. (5) DeepSeek-V3.2 publishes only DataZone meters.
